'''1B-7''', pronounced '''One-Bee-Seven''', was a [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]] owned by the Dark Lord of the One Sith, [[Darth Krayt]]. 1B-7 was assigned by Darth Wyyrlok to help the One Sith agent, [[Nyss Nenn]], bring the [[Iteration]] of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaden Korr]] out of its slumber in a [[Spaarti cloning cylinder]].<ref name="Rip">[[Riptide (novel)|''Riptide'']]</ref>
